definitions.explanation: The quality of remaining constant and unchanging over time.
In biology, the ability of an organism to maintain stable internal conditions (such as body temperature, blood sugar, etc.) despite changes in the external environment.

notes:
A compound of {恒常|こうじょう} (permanent, constant) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). In biology, this is the standard Japanese translation of "homeostasis" — the concept that living organisms actively regulate their internal environment.
